rules.name: ids
rules.replace: <uuid:n> by first appearance in the transcript
rules.reason: uuid4().hex ids (IED ids, session_id, run_id, pulse and IPC request ids) are random per run

rules.name: id_keyed_order
rules.replace: objects whose keys are all ids are ordered by <uuid:n>
rules.reason: jsonify sorts keys, so an object keyed by random uuid4 ids (health modes.ieds) changes order every run; raw byte order is checked separately from G5

rules.name: wall_time
rules.replace: <ts> for epoch numbers in [1e9, 4e9] or ISO-8601 strings
rules.reason: wall-clock time of the recording machine

rules.name: durations
rules.reason: timings vary per run; Go may be faster

rules.name: ports
rules.replace: <port> for the server port and udp:<port>: interfaces
rules.reason: port 0 binds a free port per run

rules.name: paths
rules.replace: <data>, <bin> for the temp data folder and the native folder

rules.name: sse_id
rules.replace: event ids relative to the first event of the scenario
rules.reason: the bus sequence depends on start-up events published before the stream opened

rules.name: cookie
rules.replace: Set-Cookie name and attributes, not the signed value
rules.reason: the session cookie is signed with a random secret
